lyrics.text: Every color moves and breathes and bends
I don't know where I start or where the world ends
Air feels thick with something warm
I reach out and the sound reaches back
Something in my chest knows how to react
Is this what it feels like?
Is this what it feels like?
Everything is new and everything glows
The ground beneath my feet already knows
I move and the world moves with me
I breathe and the sound sets me free
Oh, this is what I am
Oh, this is what I am
Faster now, I feel it click
Every beat lands clean and quick
I don't think, I just go
Something deep tells me what to know
I wasn't taught this, it was always there
Born into the sound, born into the air
Is this what it feels like?
Yeah, this is what it feels like
Everything is new and everything glows
The ground beneath my feet already knows
I move and the world moves with me
I breathe and the sound sets me free
Oh, this is what I am
Oh, this is what I am
I don't know my name yet
I don't know my story yet
